paite: TOUPA aw, nang ngenteltak in n'on ensuak a, n'on theita hi.
heading: Pathian Theihna Leh Khotuahna Bukim
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

paite: Nang ka tut leh ka din na thei a, gamlapi a kipan in leng ka ngaihtuahna na thei hi.
english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

paite: Ka pai leh ka lup na hon entel zel a, ka omdan tengteng na thei vek hi.
english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA aw, nang na theih siang vek louh, ka lei ah thu a-om kei hi.
english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

paite: Nang ka nunglam leh ka malam ah na hon umsuak a, ka tung ah na khut na koih lai hi.
english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

paite: Huchi tel a theihna kei a ding in alamdang lua a; asang tel a, ka phazou kei hi.
english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

paite: Na kha a pan in koi ah ka pai dia? Nang a pan koi ah ka taimang dia?
english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

paite: Van ah kahtou ning chi leng, huai ah na om ngal a; Sheol ah lupna bawl ning chi leng, ngai in, huai ah leng na om zel hi.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

paite: Zing kha zak in, tuipi tawp pek ah va om ning chi leng;
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

paite: huai ah leng na khut in na hon pi ding a, na khut taklam in hon len ding ahi ngal a.
english: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

paite: Pel lou in mial in hon khuh zou vek ding a, ka kim a vak zan ahi ding chi dek mah leng;
english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

paite: Mial in nang a pan bangmah aliah kei a, zan lah sun bang in avak hi; nang a ding in mial leh vak akibang sapsap hi.
english: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

paite: Nangmah ngei in ka lungsim na nei a; ka nu gilsung ah na hon phankhawm hi.
english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

paite: Na kiang ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a; lauhuaitak leh lamdangpi a bawl ka hih ziak in. Na thilhihte lamdangtak ahi a; huai tuh ka hinna in atheitel mahmah hi.
english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

paite: Aguk a bawl a ka om a, lei mun nuainungpen a kilawmtak a bawl a ka om lai in, ka guh ka tang nang a pan sel in a-om kei hi.
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

paite: Ka lim kibawl kim nai lou na mit in amu a, na laibu ah ka hiangte teng gelh vek ahi, anisim a bawl in a-om zel a, khat leng a-om nai louh lai in.
english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

paite: Pathian aw, na ngaihtuahnate kei a ding in manpha hi na tel e! Agawmkhawmna thupi hi na tel e!
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

paite: Sim dek mah leng, atamdan piaunel sang in atamzaw ding; ka khanloh hun in, na kiang a om nilouh ka na hi.
english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

paite: Pathian aw, migilou-saloute na that ngei ding a; huchi in sisan suah hatte'n hon paisan ding uhi.
english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

paite: Amau giloutak in nang ahon gensia un, nangmah doute'n na min agen thanghuai nak uhi.
english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

paite: TOUPA aw, nangmah hote ka ho kei a hia? Nangmah sualte tung ah ka lungkim a hia?
english: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

paite: Amau huat petmah in ka hua a; hon doute in ka sep chiat hi.
english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

paite: Pathian aw, ngenteltak in hon ensuak inla, ka lungtang thei in; hon chian inla, ka ngaihtuahnate thei in.
english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

paite: Kei ah gilou-salou lam mawngmawng a-om hia om lou, en inla, tangtawn lampi ah hon pi in.
english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
